races.paceDynamic: Institute stands alone as the only confirmed front runner in this 16-runner maiden, likely to set a comfortable pace with Forty Six A, Sands Castle, and Purely the only other prominent types. The large field will create a strung-out race with most runners settling in midfield or hold-up positions including the higher-rated Skydance, Thundering On, and the debutant newcomers. With no pace pressure on Institute early, this tactical setup strongly favors the hold-up horses who can finish late down the outside of the large field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Institute sets uncontested fractions and the pace becomes pedestrian
scenarios.body: The large field bunches up and creates traffic problems for prominent runners, while the hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash late runs down the outside. Skydance and Thundering On are ideally positioned to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Creates Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Forty Six A and Purely join Institute in a genuine pace battle early
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and sets up a proper test, allowing horses with tactical pace like the debutant Elmakaya or Beatific to strike in the final furlong. The front runners fade under pressure.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Institute Wires the Field
scenarios.trigger: If the lone pace-setter maintains a steady rhythm and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: With no sustained pressure throughout, Institute gets the perfect tactical trip and proves too strong for the hold-up brigade who are left with too much to do. The prominent runners fill the frame.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If traffic problems and a stop-start pace create chaos in the straight
scenarios.body: The established runners get inconvenienced by the large field dynamics while a lightly-raced newcomer like Rodeo Blues or Cromac Quay gets a clean run at the right time. Fresh legs prevail over experience.

watchPoints.text: Institute must be watched for market support despite 163-day absence as the lone pace-setter
Skydance carries the strongest form rating but 210-day layoff is a significant concern in competitive maiden
Beatific and Elmakaya represent top connections making debuts and should be monitored for betting moves
Traffic problems are likely given the 16-runner field size and Leopardstown's configuration
Several O'Brien runners (Institute, Purely, Beatific) may not all be trying to win with stable having multiple chances

races.paceDynamic: Romantic War is the sole confirmed front runner in this large field and will face no early pressure, allowing him to dictate a steady gallop through the opening stages. With several prominent racers like Sedro Woolley and Searcog likely to track him, but most runners adopting hold-up tactics, the pace will be moderate rather than searching. The large field of mainly hold-up horses will create congestion in the final two furlongs as they all look for racing room simultaneously. This sustainable pace followed by a cavalry charge finish clearly favours horses with turn of foot who can pick their way through traffic - the hold-up brigade holds all the aces here.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Nightmare
scenarios.trigger: If the 20+ hold-up horses bunch together turning for home creating severe traffic problems
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace leaves too much to do for those caught behind runners, but those with the best turn of foot who get clear runs will prevail. Launch Time and Miss Americana have shown the class to win from these tactics.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent racers can secure an ideal position tracking Romantic War and avoid the backmarker scramble
scenarios.body: Searcog or Sedro Woolley get first run on the leaders and kick clear before the hold-up horses can organize their challenges. Their forward positions prove crucial in this big field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lone Leader Lasts
scenarios.trigger: If Romantic War maintains his advantage and the chasing pack fails to mount a serious challenge due to traffic issues
scenarios.body: The moderate pace suits the front runner perfectly and he stays on grimly while the better horses are stuck behind beaten runners. His 9lb penalty becomes irrelevant if he avoids pressure.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Finds Daylight
scenarios.trigger: If a well-handicapped hold-up horse gets a dream run through while the fancied runners hit trouble
scenarios.body: My Girl Robyn or Clifftop benefit from their low weights and Andrew Slattery's strong form to strike at big odds. The race falls apart tactically for the market leaders.

watchPoints.text: Romantic War runs yesterday at Gowran and backs up here 24 hours later - stamina and recovery a major concern

races.paceDynamic: Walhaan is the only confirmed front runner in this 18-runner field and should get an uncontested lead with Sonoran, Fixation and Vega's Muse likely to settle prominently behind. The pace will be sustainable rather than fierce with no obvious pace pressure, allowing Walhaan to dictate terms through steady fractions. With 13 of the 18 runners having hold-up styles, there will be a massive pack of horses waiting to pounce from the rear over the final 2-3 furlongs. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late runs, as they'll benefit from the steady gallop and have tactical positioning advantages in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Walhaan sets steady fractions uncontested through the first half-mile
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace allows the large group of hold-up horses to close strongly, with the best-handicapped getting first run on the leaders. Multiple hold-up horses will hit the line together with the strongest stayers prevailing.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Sonoran or Fixation apply more pace pressure than expected on Walhaan
scenarios.body: The increased gallop stretches the field earlier and favours horses positioned just off the pace who can quicken without needing to make up too much ground. The prominent runners get first run before the hold-up brigade arrives.

races.paceDynamic: Flushing Meadows and Iron Lily will contest the early lead, with Flushing Meadows likely to establish control given Ryan Moore's tactical awareness and the colt's proven ability to dictate from the front. The presence of two genuine front runners should create an honest gallop rather than crawling fractions, with prominent runners like Dorset, Geryon, and Power Blue tracking within striking distance. The pace will be testing but not suicidal, as both leaders have shown they can sustain their efforts. This race shape favours prominent runners who can sit close to the pace and kick in the final two furlongs, as they'll avoid the scramble from the back while not bearing the full brunt of making the running.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Pounces

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.body: The Publican's Son can utilize his hold up style to sweep past tired horses in the final furlong. His 108 RPR suggests he has the class to capitalize if the race falls apart up front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If chaos unfolds with the leaders going too fast and prominent horses getting hampered
scenarios.body: Warsaw or Mumhan can emerge from the pack to steal victory at big odds. Their relative freshness and unproven status at this level makes this the least likely but most rewarding outcome.

races.paceDynamic: Black Caviar Gold, Kensington Lane, and Slaney View will set a strong gallop from the start, with six prominent runners (True Love, Blanc De Blanc, White Lily, Pivotal Attack, Suzie Songs, Magny Cours) creating significant early congestion. The genuine pace will ensure a true test of stamina over 7f on yielding ground, with the large field likely causing traffic problems turning for home. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early scrimmaging and finish with one sustained run, as the strong gallop will set up perfectly for closers with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders maintain a genuine gallop and the prominent brigade gets into a speed duel
scenarios.body: The strong pace will perfectly set up the race for closers who can get a clear run in the final 2f. Mayflower, Composing, and Caught U Sleeping are ideally positioned to benefit from this scenario.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapses early
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast early and burn out, leaving a slow middle section
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where prominent runners with tactical speed can pounce late. This neutralizes the stamina advantage and favours horses with a sharp turn of foot.

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.trigger: If Black Caviar Gold can establish a clear lead and the chasers fail to organize an effective pursuit
scenarios.body: Her proven stamina and recent form suggest she could wire the field if allowed to dictate comfortable fractions. Kensington Lane or Slaney View would need to falter for this scenario.

The honest gallop should play out steadily rather than turning into a sprint, with the pace likely to strengthen from 3f out as the leaders come under pressure. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses - Italy, A Boy Named Susie and Victory Tip - who can avoid the early scrimmaging and finish powerfully into a solid tempo.

races.paceDynamic: Cape Cod is the only confirmed front-runner in this small field, likely to set uncontested fractions with the prominent runners Madbadanddangerous, Cherry Hill Girl, and Marjorie Daw content to track rather than challenge early. The pace will be steady rather than searching, with no pressure applied until the home turn when the prominent brigade engage. This controlled tempo over 1m2f sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses Pierre Grosse, So Must I, and Another Day Done to deliver their finishing kicks. The lack of early pace and sustainable gallop strongly favours hold-up runners who can produce late acceleration.
